description: This PHP class 'SubunitModel' represents a data model for a 'Subunit' entity in the OrangeHRM system, used for serialization and API responses. It implements the 'Normalizable' interface and incorporates traits for model serialization. It defines how a 'Subunit' entity is exposed via the API, including its attributes and filters.

classes.name: SubunitModel
classes.description: A model class for serializing 'Subunit' entities in the OrangeHRM API. Implements normalization, defines attributes, and filters for API responses.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the SubunitModel with a Subunit entity, setting entity data, filters, and attribute names for serialization.
